== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The first surviving text can imprison in any prison or put the card in the opponent’s Used Pile. The remaster makes this capture with its imprison-or-escape choices. The alternative Effect deployment retains the cost, console condition and ordinary owner deployment timing.
